name: HSPLANT
recent: Hap Seng Plantations 于 2026 年 11 月 17 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，并宣布多项董事会及委员会人事变动，包括 Choy Khai Choon 于 11 月 18 日起辞任独立非执行董事。公司此前于 8 月宣布派发每股 2 仙的首次中期股息，并已下调 2026 财年鲜果串产量指引。
notable: 宣布 2026 财年每股 2 仙的首次中期股息。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩。
Choy Khai Choon 辞任独立非执行董事，Datuk Hamisa Binti Samat 获委任为提名委员会主席，均于 2026 年 11 月 18 日生效。
risks: 公司因沙巴干旱下调 2026 财年鲜果串产量指引。
季度净利同比下降 7% 至约 4,800 万令吉，尽管棕油价格走高。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 2.017 亿令吉，环比增长 4.8%，同比增长 29.2%；净利为 3,932 万令吉，环比增长 294.4%，同比增长 100.0%；净利率为 19.5%，高于上一季度的 5.2%。

recent_en: Hap Seng Plantations released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 17 November 2026, alongside several board and committee changes, including the resignation of Choy Khai Choon as Independent Non-Executive Director effective 18 November. The company had earlier declared a first interim dividend of 2 sen per share in August and cut its FY2026 fresh fruit bunch production guidance.
notable_en: Declared a first interim dividend of 2 sen per share for FY2026.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
Choy Khai Choon resigned as Independent Non-Executive Director, and Datuk Hamisa Binti Samat was appointed Chairperson of the Nomination Committee, both effective 18 November 2026.
risks_en: The company cut its FY2026 fresh fruit bunch production guidance due to a dry spell in Sabah.
Quarterly net profit fell 7% year-on-year to about RM48 million despite higher CPO prices.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM201.7 million, up 4.8% QoQ and 29.2% YoY; net income was RM39.3 million, up 294.4% QoQ and 100.0% YoY; net margin was 19.5%, up from 5.2% in the previous quarter.
